notes.text:
# Campaign Home

Welcome to your Pathfinder 2e campaign vault.

## Campaign
- **Campaign name:**
- **Setting:**
- **Party level:** 1
- **Next session:**

## Start here
- [[Campaign Overview]]
- [[Sessions/Session 01|Session 01]]

## Notes
Keep session notes in **Sessions**, PCs and NPCs in **Characters**, places in **Locations**, organizations in **Factions**, and battles in **Encounters**.

## Using this vault
- Link notes with `[[Note Name]]`.
- Embed an image with `![[image.png]]`.
- Store maps, portraits, and other files in **Attachments**.
- Create a note, then use **Templates: Insert template** from the command palette to insert a template.
- Open the graph view to explore connections between notes.
